calibration.source: Claude focused-proof calibration evidence, extended for saved-team trust boundaries 2026-09-25 and the automatic rework cap 2026-09-26
calibration.rule: Each case selects one assertion identity from the narrowest assertion-failing test file; the streaming case uses its saved red/green proof.

cases.boundary: fingerprint match ignores location

proof.testName: saving a team and bringing it back recognises only the exact project save at its original path (PelagoWebsite two-folder case)

cases.boundary: an unrecognised project file restores without review

proof.testName: pre-0.9.87 saved permission review requires an unticked review for every unrecognised project save, never for the personal library

cases.boundary: automatic rework is never capped

proof.testName: automatic rework is bounded until the user writes sends two rounds, holds the third with a host line, ignores wakes, and re-arms on a user message

cases.boundary: verdict crosses routes (a Smart Mode model switch inherits another gateway's accounting)

proof.testName: OpenAICompatBackend usage reconciliation — invariants across the whole state space does not carry a verdict across a model switch

cases.boundary: Plan mode honors a stored Full access profile instead of resolving downward to Read only

proof.testName: Codex permission profiles forces Plan and every host ceiling to Read only

cases.boundary: a malformed persisted Codex permission profile resolves upward to Full access

proof.testName: Codex permission profiles defaults missing and malformed stored values downward to Ask for approval

cases.boundary: danger-full-access reaches the Codex argv without the resolved Full access profile

proof.testName: Codex permission profiles allows the unsandboxed argv only for the resolved Full access profile

cases.boundary: a subfolder Codex agent is missing from the trust override, so Codex writes trust into the user config

proof.testName: CodexBackend App Server covers the working directory and every folder up to the workspace root in the trust override

cases.boundary: Codex turns disable environment access, which removes the escalated-retry path

proof.testName: CodexBackend App Server pins thread and turn policy and refuses a response that weakens it

cases.boundary: a read-only root is sent as a Codex workspace root, which thread/resume makes writable

proof.testName: CodexBackend App Server never sends a read-only root as a Codex workspace root, because resume makes it writable

cases.boundary: a workspace-write Codex thread with writable temp folders is accepted

proof.testName: CodexBackend App Server refuses a workspace-write thread whose temp folders are writable

cases.boundary: an agent limited by Folder Access grants resolves to an unsandboxed Full access process

proof.testName: Codex permission profiles never gives an agent limited by Folder Access an unsandboxed process

cases.boundary: a partial Codex command action can authorize a different transported command

proof.testName: CodexBackend App Server checks the full transported command when a single Codex action summarizes only part of it

cases.boundary: a refused CLI start leaves the queued chat turn pending

proof.testName: SessionManager egress-consent start lifecycle (B6) terminates the queued chat turn with the refusal reason and starts the next message as a fresh turn

cases.boundary: inclusive can be re-declared exclusive (retroactively reinterprets everything the gateway said)

proof.testName: OpenAICompatBackend usage reconciliation — invariants across the whole state space only ever declares a route inverted on a proof, never on a guess

cases.boundary: reconstruction drops the gateway's own figure (under-reports the prompt)

proof.testName: OpenAICompatBackend usage reconciliation — reference-model conformance agrees with the reference model on EVERY sequence to depth 4 over the order-type alphabet

cases.boundary: declares exclusive without the append-only witness (libels an honest gateway on a legitimate trim)

proof.testName: OpenAICompatBackend does not mistake a hash-colliding rewrite (Aa→BB) for an append-only request

cases.boundary: append-only witness degraded back to a token-estimate comparison (Codex: ceil() is not order-preserving)

proof.testName: OpenAICompatBackend does not mistake a hash-colliding rewrite (Aa→BB) for an append-only request

cases.boundary: the money estimator stops leaning high (under-counts CJK, code, images)

proof.testName: TokenCounter (P2 context gates) estimates higher for the money path than for the context guard

cases.boundary: images priced at 256 tokens again (a high-detail image is ~1,100-1,600)

proof.testName: TokenCounter (P2 context gates) prices an image like an image on the money path — 256 tokens was fiction

cases.boundary: the runtime invariant guard is bypassed (a future bug reaches the bill)

proof.testName: OpenAICompatBackend usage reconciliation — reference-model conformance repairs an invariant-violating candidate upward, never letting it reach the bill

cases.boundary: a gateway that reports no usage books the turn at zero (the JSON-fallback path)

proof.testName: OpenAICompatBackend books a turn honestly when the stream dies and the JSON fallback reports no usage at all

cases.boundary: a repaired nonsense report (cached > prompt) is passed off as the gateway's own bill

proof.testName: OpenAICompatBackend flags a repaired nonsense usage report as an estimate rather than showing it as a bill

cases.boundary: the cache breakpoint is left in the append-only witness (its own movement reads as a rewrite)

proof.testName: OpenAICompatBackend reconstructs a usage report that is secretly counting in Anthropic units

cases.boundary: the witness stores a 32-bit hash of the bytes instead of the bytes (Aa/BB collide; honest rewrite latches exclusive)

proof.testName: OpenAICompatBackend does not mistake a hash-colliding rewrite (Aa→BB) for an append-only request

cases.boundary: the final OpenAI-compatible route assertion is removed before fetch

proof.testName: OpenAICompatBackend checks the final route boundary before fetch and proves the identical positive path fetches once

cases.boundary: the final OpenAI-compatible route assertion is removed before streaming fetch

proof.testName: OpenAICompatBackend checks the final route boundary before streaming fetch and proves the identical positive path streams once

cases.boundary: a forged Custom route reads another registered connection key

proof.testName: OpenAICompatBackend refuses a forged custom profile key before it can make a request

cases.boundary: the final route boundary trusts the config key name instead of the registered connection

proof.testName: E0 route contracts keeps the host-side final boundary on registry-derived credential identities

cases.boundary: the final Codex route assertion is removed before spawn

proof.testName: CodexBackend App Server CodexBackend Track A does not spawn when the final route boundary rejects, while an identical positive path spawns once

cases.boundary: Codex App Server starts without the direct-OpenAI consent gate

proof.testName: CodexBackend App Server asks for consent before preflight or spawn and declining creates no process

cases.boundary: Codex launches without asking about repository configuration

proof.testName: CodexBackend App Server reviews repository configuration before consent and revalidates immediately before spawn

cases.boundary: Codex is prewarmed during restore after consent was stored

proof.testName: shouldPrewarmBackend never starts any backend during activation, selection, reload, or restore

cases.boundary: repository approval remains valid after its configuration digest changes

proof.testName: repository CLI configuration boundary binds approval to the canonical workspace, actual cwd, CLI kind, and all configuration bytes

cases.boundary: repository CLI configuration discovery stops at the opened subfolder again

proof.testName: repository CLI configuration boundary discovers executable CLI configuration above an opened repository subfolder

cases.boundary: declining Claude project automation still loads project settings

proof.testName: ClaudeHeadlessBackend repository automation boundary asks before egress, disables only the project layer on decline, and revalidates before spawn

cases.boundary: an unknown Codex App Server request is accepted instead of declined

proof.testName: CodexBackend App Server declines unknown, malformed, timed-out, and host-forbidden requests without inventing approval

cases.boundary: the final Claude route assertion is removed before spawn

proof.testName: ClaudeHeadlessBackend fail-closed PreToolUse gate checks the final route boundary before the Claude process spawns

cases.boundary: canonical endpoint comparison is weakened to hostname-only (base-path crossing)

proof.testName: E0 route contracts rejects a mismatched resolved envelope before an egress caller can use it

cases.boundary: canonical endpoint folds path case (distinct bases become equal)

proof.testName: E0 route contracts canonicalizes only the pinned endpoint components, never a lossy path form

cases.boundary: command capability is allowed without an approval mechanism

proof.testName: E0 route contracts makes credentials unrepresentable in serialized routes and rejects dynamic invalid capabilities

cases.boundary: a stale custom profile revision is allowed to reuse its old endpoint and key

proof.testName: E0 route contracts rejects a stale custom runtime profile after endpoint or key identity changes

cases.boundary: a custom gateway borrows a global list price without connection-specific provenance

proof.testName: ModelPricing never borrows global list prices for a custom connection

cases.boundary: an empty tool-active delegation is treated as verified again

proof.testName: TeamTools role-spread (multiple same-role teammates) does not mark a real tool-active delegated reply verified when the coordinator receives no delivery (T4)

cases.boundary: F2 tool activity is over-credited as a green delivery verdict

proof.testName: TeamTools (PM coordinator) classifies delegated replies from framework evidence, not the teammate's Done text

cases.boundary: a task-scope refusal is collapsed into a terminal workspace escape

proof.testName: WorkspaceTools folder access write roots distinguishes a recoverable task-scope refusal from an escape outside the configured workspace

cases.boundary: a task-scope refusal again terminates the model turn

proof.testName: OpenAICompatBackend keeps a task-scope refusal recoverable so the next turn iteration can read a granted input

cases.boundary: a real workspace escape is made recoverable as task scope

proof.testName: WorkspaceTools folder access write roots allows writes in any configured write root and blocks outside them

cases.boundary: a declined local read consent is reported as a task-scope refusal

proof.testName: WorkspaceTools local read scope fails closed, suppresses an immediate retry, and re-asks on a new user request

cases.boundary: task-scope prose falls through to a false consent denial

proof.testName: WorkspaceTools folder access write roots distinguishes a recoverable task-scope refusal from an escape outside the configured workspace

cases.boundary: directory listings are rendered as reads again

proof.testName: toolSummary classifies built-in tools for chat cards

cases.boundary: configured-but-not-granted writes are made terminal again

proof.testName: OpenAICompatBackend keeps a write inside the configured workspace but outside a task scope recoverable, while a real write escape remains terminal

cases.boundary: configured-but-not-granted symlink targets are made terminal again

proof.testName: OpenAICompatBackend distinguishes task-scope and real-escape symlink targets without weakening the physical-path boundary

cases.boundary: an unavailable image asset is again allowed to terminate the turn

proof.testName: OpenAICompatBackend visibly omits an image asset when the route capability is unknown without opening media consent

cases.boundary: a coordinator brief bypasses destination-specific consent

proof.testName: TeamTools (PM coordinator) refuses a declined coordinator-brief egress before creating an attempt or starting a worker

cases.boundary: an ungranted coordinator brief basis is dispatched anyway

proof.testName: v0.9.61 Task Contract rejects an otherwise optional brief basis that was not actually granted

cases.boundary: an optional input silently restores the no-web substitution rule

proof.testName: v0.9.61 Task Contract makes input-substitution guidance conditional on required inputs, not any input

cases.boundary: a coordinator brief leaks into persisted activity or conversation history

proof.testName: MessageBus persistence (P1#5) keeps coordinator briefs in the live task attempt but not activity or conversation persistence

cases.boundary: an unresolved manual route inherits equality from a provider label instead of its exact endpoint

proof.testName: E0 route contracts compares coordinator brief destinations by privacy domain, with exact execution fallback only for unresolved manual routes

cases.boundary: the live-task artifact detail is dropped after the generic refusal is rendered

proof.testName: WorkspaceTools sandbox hardening keeps generic refusals byte-identical and appends only the reviewed artifact detail

cases.boundary: a refusal detail interpolates host state instead of remaining literal-only

proof.testName: WorkspaceTools sandbox hardening keeps generic refusals byte-identical and appends only the reviewed artifact detail

cases.boundary: the unknown-input refusal discloses that an unauthorised source exists

proof.testName: v0.9.61 attempt-bound Input Resolver enforces grants through the real content tools without adding write, command, or network authority

cases.boundary: a stale unadvertised task tool is misclassified as another harness tool

proof.testName: OpenAICompatBackend hides task-only tools without an attempt but routes a stale artifact call to its guarded refusal

cases.boundary: the frozen Claude bridge loses its no-live-attempt artifact handler guard

proof.testName: ClaudeHeadlessBackend read-only files bridge keeps the artifact handler guard on the frozen bridge when no task attempt is live

cases.boundary: Claude stops advertising the task artifact in its one-time bridge schema

proof.testName: ClaudeHeadlessBackend read-only files bridge keeps its one-time tools/list schema, including task tools whose handlers still require a live attempt

cases.boundary: a Codex Playbook grants workspace-write authority

proof.testName: CodexBackend App Server never lets a Playbook grant workspace-write or persist roots into Codex configuration

cases.boundary: Codex extra Skill roots persist into user configuration

proof.testName: CodexBackend App Server never lets a Playbook grant workspace-write or persist roots into Codex configuration

cases.boundary: one Codex agent receives another agent's Playbook namespace

proof.testName: CodexBackend App Server gives two Codex agents disjoint native-Skill names and roots

cases.boundary: a safety-stopped worker reaches the coordinator as completed work

proof.testName: SessionManager <-> MessageBus routing routes a safety stop as typed partial work, never task.complete or worker failure

cases.boundary: the forced safety-stop final request offers tools again

proof.testName: OpenAICompatBackend turns a custom maxToolIterations cap into a typed stop and a tool-free forced answer

cases.boundary: continuing a stopped task re-dispatches the original prompt from scratch

proof.testName: TeamTools (PM coordinator) continues a safety-stopped task on the same worker conversation with fresh attempt authority

cases.boundary: a typed safety stop increments the model-fallback failure streak

proof.testName: SessionManager model fallback (P1#6) leaves the fallback failure counter unchanged for a typed stopped turn

cases.boundary: a quarantined MCP connection never enters recovery

proof.testName: MCPHub discards a late response after post-dispatch cancellation, then remounts before the next call

cases.boundary: the tool-free safety closeout replays structured tool history

proof.testName: OpenAICompatBackend turns a custom maxToolIterations cap into a typed stop and a tool-free forced answer

cases.boundary: Claude managed MCP calls lose opaque-bridge audit attribution

proof.testName: buildClaudeMcpConfig attributes Claude managed calls through only an exact opaque integrations bridge

cases.boundary: closeout tool results lose the untrusted framing

proof.testName: OpenAICompatBackend frames safety-closeout tool results as untrusted data in the outgoing request

cases.boundary: attribution accepts a bridge ID other than the session's

proof.testName: buildClaudeMcpConfig attributes Claude managed calls through only an exact opaque integrations bridge
